title: Clause 7 - Support
description: Working paper template for ISO/IEC 42001 Clause 7: resources, competence, awareness, communication, documented information.

sections.title: Resources (7.1)
prompts: Verify allocation of human, financial, and technical resources to the AIMS.
Confirm specialised AI competencies (data science, ML ops, ethics) are resourced.

sections.title: Competence (7.2)
prompts: Verify AI-related role competence requirements are documented.
Confirm training records cover AI-specific topics for in-scope personnel.

sections.title: Awareness (7.3)
prompts: Confirm staff are aware of the AI policy, their responsibilities, incident reporting paths.

sections.title: Communication (7.4)
prompts: Confirm internal and external AI communication processes (incidents, transparency notices).

sections.title: Documented information (7.5)
prompts: Verify the AIMS document register; check version control and retention.

checklists.text: Competence matrix exists for AI roles.
Awareness training completed by relevant staff (sample).
AIMS document register has owners and review dates.

suggestedInterviewQuestions: How do you assess AI-specific competencies before assigning a role?
Walk us through how an AI incident would be communicated externally.
Sample: show training completion records for three in-scope developers.
